what: one row per episode: outcome, frame health, sync
how: ldp gold build, from models/gold_episode_stats.sql over silver, overwrite

docs.description: One row for each promoted episode, with its outcome, the health of its frames and the sync of its cameras. A clip is clean when it dropped under 2% of its frames and its RGB and depth cameras never drifted 20 ms apart.

columns.episode_id: The episode, one teleoperated attempt at a task. It starts with the id of its upload batch.
columns.batch_id: The upload batch the episode arrived in.
columns.robot_id: The robot that recorded the episode.
columns.task: The task the robot was asked to do.
columns.start_ts: When the episode started, in UTC.
columns.end_ts: When the episode ended, in UTC.
columns.duration_s: How long the episode lasted, in seconds.
columns.success: Whether the robot completed the task.
columns.frame_count: How many frames the episode says it has.
columns.frames_recorded: How many frames of the episode silver holds.
columns.dropped_frames: How many of those frames were dropped by the recorder.
columns.drop_rate: The share of its frames that were dropped, from 0 to 1.
columns.max_skew_ms: The largest gap between the RGB and depth timestamps of any frame, in milliseconds.
columns.p95_skew_ms: The 95th percentile of that gap over the frames of the episode, in milliseconds.
columns.clean: True when the drop rate is under 2% and the skew never reached 20 ms.
